model_annotation: This pie chart visually represents a comparison of categories related to approximate number generation, disjunctive, and conjunctive relationships. The chart is divided into eight slices, and includes a legend identifying each category. The slices, in descending order of size, are labeled "Disjunctive & Conjunctive" (50.49%), "Conjunctive" (49.51%), "Approximate Quantities" (45.03%), "Comparative Relationships" (36.26%), "Universal Quantifiers" (29.07%), "Negation" (27.91%), "Limiter" (27.91%), and "Existential" (15.12%). Percentage labels are displayed within each slice.
